newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin gets $100 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin gets $100 mln contract.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Federal Systems, a Lockheed Martin Corp subsidiary, said on Monday that it received a five-year, $100 million contract from the National Institutes of Health to support federal agencies with document management.

ImageWorld, the name of the project Lockheed Martin is working on with this contract, addresses the electronic imaging requirements of the federal government, including forms processing, document conversion, electronic storage, and clinical, biological and radiological systems.
